regulo.name: field-label-visible
regulo.kialo: WCAG 3.3.2 (Labels or Instructions): a placeholder disappears while typing, and a label only a screen reader hears does not help the sighted person who finds the field half filled.

issue.message: Instance 0 of listelektilo has the placeholder "Status filtern" and no label: the placeholder stands in for the label.
issue.suggestion: Give the label as the text of the element or as label="…" and keep the placeholder as an example of a value.

regulo.name: placeholder-not-label

regulo.name: select-placeholder-is-prompt
regulo.kialo: The empty field of a select shows its placeholder where a chosen option will stand; a single word there reads as an option already chosen, and a person sends the form without choosing. A prompt says that nothing is chosen yet. Unlike the placeholder of a kampo it is no example of a value: the values are the options.
